data.title: Years after Islamic State's defeat, French jihadists face justice in Iraq
data.description: BAGHDAD - A decade ago, the Islamic State group broadcast its crimes as it recruited radicals from around the world and imposed a brutal system of oppression across swathes of Syria and Iraq.

data.title: Fire sweeps through houses in Bangkok community
data.description: A fire swept through 79 houses in Patthana Bon Kai community in Bangkok in the early hours of Monday. There there were no injuries reported.

data.title: Cathay Pacific says data from 53,000 bookings compromised in Amadeus cyberattack
data.description: Hong Kong flag carrier Cathay Pacific Airways has revealed that personal data and flight details of 53,000 bookings were compromised after hackers breached its technology service provider's system.

data.title: ONE Championship: Haggerty knee ruled legal in unanimous 12–0 review, source says
data.description: An independent review has unanimously ruled Jonathan Haggerty’s disputed knee against Hiroki Akimoto legal, the Bangkok Post understands, leaving his ONE Championship bantamweight kickboxing title victory intact.

data.title: Belief, business, Bangkok: What do people pray for?
data.description: Superstitions have always run deep in Thailand, from before the arrival of Buddhism to the modern age of technology. In Bangkok, interest in spirituality and fortune-seeking has become increasingly visible, with the practice popularly dubbed “mutelu”.

data.title: South Korea to double spending on AI and chips in 2027
data.description: SEOUL — South Korea will double spending on artificial intelligence (AI) and semiconductors in 2027 to a record high, the president said Monday, pledging to use the technology to turn the military into a "smart, elite force".

data.title: First point for Dragons, Port slump again
data.description: Ratchaburi claimed their first point of the AFC Champions League Elite on Tuesday night, holding Japan’s Kashiwa Reysol to a goalless draw, but Port slipped to a third straight defeat with a 3-0 loss at Johor Darul Ta’zim.

data.title: Big payday! Thailand’s heroes pocket Bt123m in rewards
data.description: Thailand’s Asian Para Games athletes enjoyed a big payday as they bagged over 123 million baht in cash rewards following their excellent performance at Aichi-Nagoya 2026 in Japan this month.

data.title: Concordian International School Expands Facilities for Student Growth
data.description: As international education continues to evolve, the spaces in which students learn are becoming just as important as the curricula they follow. At Concordian International School, a series of campus enhancements reflects this changing approach, with new and upgraded facilities designed to enrich the student experience both inside and beyond the classroom.

data.title: Halloween 'Monsterverse' awaits at Central Embassy
data.description: Central Embassy invites everyone to celebrate Halloween with a host of creative activities and lifestyle experiences in the “Monsterverse”, which is running at Open House on the 6th floor, until Sunday.

data.title: Indonesia in  focus during 'Sudo Rungu'
data.description: Indonesian contemporary artist Roby Dwi Antono is now showcasing his first solo exhibition in Thailand titled “Sudo Rungu: Echoes Of Fire”, which draws on memories from his father who worked as a blacksmith, at Moca Museum of Contemporary Art from now until Jan 3.

data.title: Get your pasta passport for 'The Taste Of Italy'
data.description: The Embassy of Italy invites lovers of Italian cuisine to enjoy their favourite dishes and earn prizes during “Taste Of Italy Passport: Discover. Taste. Collect. Unlock”, which will take place throughout November.

data.title: Hong Kong beautician gets 4 years for selling friends to Myanmar scam hub
data.description: A Hong Kong beautician has been sentenced to four years in jail for tricking two friends into forced labour and confinement in Myanmar's notorious "KK Park" scam farm, with a judge slamming her actions as "vicious and inhumane".

data.title: True Corporation: Business Reinvention Sets Telecom-Tech Companies Apart
data.description: As AI becomes a technology accessible to every organization, competitive advantage will no longer lie in who has the most state-of-the-art AI. Instead, it will depend on who can use data, transform processes, and develop people’s capabilities to create tangible business value. The future of telecom-tech companies will not be measured solely by the strength of networks. It will also depend on their ability to redesign the business model for the future and reinvent the business as a whole.

data.title: 'Grateful' Antonelli becomes youngest Formula One world champion
data.description: MEXICO CITY — Kimi Antonelli became Formula One's youngest world champion and Italy's first since 1953 when he finished third behind multiple champions Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton in Sunday's thrilling and crash-hit Mexico City Grand Prix.

data.title: Arsenal ride out Liverpool storm to top Premier League
data.description: LIVERPOOL — Arsenal moved to the top of the Premier League with their first win away to Liverpool in 14 years as Kai Havertz's early strike secured a 1-0 victory for the Gunners.

data.title: Dismantling drug networks
data.description: The new commissioner of the Narcotics Suppression Bureau (NSB) has vowed to intensify the crackdown on illegal narcotics, expanding checkpoints nationwide and invoking special legal provisions against cross-border trafficking networks.

data.title: Nine people dead in Learjet crash in south Florida
data.description: Private ​jet had taken off ⁠from Austin, ⁠Texas and headed to Bahamas, ​FAA says, as NTSB has launched investigation into crash

data.title: Violence after Germany's 'Gen Z' demos slammed by politicians
data.description: FRANKFURT — Multiple German politicians on Sunday criticised clashes and looting the day before on the margins of youth-led demonstrations, though several also warned that the acts should not eclipse the protesters' demands.

data.title: Chinese state TV fails to air Real Madrid match after Mbappe row
data.description: BEIJING — Chinese state broadcaster China Central Television ( CCTV ) did not broadcast a Real Madrid La Liga match on Sunday after star forward Kylian Mbappe caused a furore in China with remarks he made about former leader Mao Zedong.

data.title: Lany in Bangkok to go hard with Soft
data.description: Multi-platinum pop band Lany will be in Bangkok for an intimate yet powerful concert experience for fans at UOB Live, Emsphere, Sukhumvit Road, on Nov 10 at 8pm.

data.title: Living authentically
data.description: For all the glitter, extravagant costumes and larger-than-life performances associated with drag, the story behind the makeup can be considerably more complicated. In Heals, Thai-American filmmaker Pailin Wedel turns her camera on drag queen Pangina Heals, or Pan Pan Narkprasert, to explore family expectations, emotional wounds and the search for acceptance.

data.title: Exploring queer intimacy
data.description: After arriving in Thailand over a year ago, Olivier Chow opened a queer art gallery on the ground floor of his shophouse in Bangkok's Chinatown in June. Adult Material is dedicated to contemporary queer art in the region and beyond.

data.title: Iran warns new war could last longer after Trump threatens strikes
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran warned on Sunday that any renewed war with the United States could last longer than the previous round of fighting, after President Donald Trump said he still had to "take care" of more targets.
